Uzbekistan is one of travel’s great surprises. For centuries, it was the beating heart of the Silk Road — the ancient network connecting China, India, Persia, the Middle East and Europe.
כיום, מטיילים מכל העולם מגלים מחדש את המ: Today, travellers from around the world are rediscovering this fascinating country. Ancient cities, magnificent Islamic architecture, famous blue domes, colourful markets and warm hospitality make every visit memorable.
